# `aitbc trade match-all`

Match all open inter-chain trades automatically.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc trade match-all [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc trade match-all
```
